title: Voxi ASR Model Registry
description: Local ASR models Voxi may invoke and the per-model hallucination stop-word patterns used to filter transcripts.

default_model.description: Model name used when no --model flag is given. Must be a key in models.

speech_context.description: Bounded static terminology and limits for opt-in Whisper decoder context.

transcript_safety.description: Conservative pre-injection transcript circuit breaker limits, measured in Unicode characters.

models.description: Map of local ASR model name to its configuration.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the monitor TUI and CLI help.

engine.description: Inference engine backing this model. 'whisper' dispatches through voxtype; 'cohere-transcribe' dispatches through the crispasr binary (see issue 074); 'openai-transcribe' calls an OpenAI-API-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions HTTP endpoint (see issue 126) -- no local binary.

does_llm_cleanup.description: If true, this engine already applies LLM-based transcript cleanup server-side, so eager mode skips its own cleanWithLLM pass for this model even when the user's llm_cleaner setting is on (avoids double cleanup).

api_model.description: The model id sent as the "model" field of the request to an openai-transcribe engine's /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint (e.g. "whisper-1"). Distinct from this entry's own map key, which is voxi's spec model name and is never meaningful to the remote server. Required when engine is 'openai-transcribe'; ignored otherwise.

stop_words.description: Case-insensitive regex fragments matching known hallucinated phrases this model tends to leak (e.g. YouTube outros, subtitle credits). Applied both to reject whole-utterance hallucinations and to strip trailing hallucinated tails from otherwise-genuine speech.

requires_gpu.description: If true, this model must not run on the CPU backend: eager mode falls back to cpu_fallback (or refuses to start if unset) when no GPU render node is present, and `voxi bench` skips its cpu row instead of executing it. Set this when docs/BenchBaseline.md (or an equivalent measurement) shows CPU RTF > 1.0 (sub-realtime) for the model.

cpu_fallback.description: Model to substitute when requires_gpu is true and no GPU render node is present. Must name another entry in models, and that entry must not itself require a GPU. Ignored when requires_gpu is false.

response_format.description: The "response_format" field sent to an openai-transcribe engine's /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint. Omitted/"text" (the default) sends response_format=text and treats the response body as the plain transcript (issue 126 whisper-server contract). "json" sends response_format=json and parses the {"type":...,"text":...} envelope some backends require instead (see issue 134). Ignored by engines other than openai-transcribe.

strip_before_marker.description: For an openai-transcribe engine, discards everything up to and including the last occurrence of this literal substring in the transcript text, keeping only what follows -- used when a backend prepends metadata before the actual transcript (e.g. R2T2's "language <NAME><asr_text>..." leak, issue 134 §6). A no-op when unset or when the marker is not found in the text. Ignored by engines other than openai-transcribe.
